Hi all!
I am looking for a reliable, long-term freight forwarder for regular door-to-door shipments from China to Belgrade, Serbia.

Details for the upcoming trial shipment:

Weight: ~5-10 kg (single box)

Service required: Door-to-door (Full pickup in China and delivery to my door in Belgrade)

Terms: Strictly DDP (Customs clearance and all local duties/taxes must be handled by you and included in the price)

Shipping method: Air Freight / Special Line preferred for faster transit

Please send your quotes or PM me with:

1. Your rate per kg (all-inclusive DDP price)

2. Estimated transit time to Serbia

3. Contact info (WeChat / WhatsApp)

Note: If the trial shipment goes smoothly, we will switch to a regular weekly/monthly schedule. Looking for transparent pricing and clear communication. Thank you!
